title: Torsion coefficient complexes admit torsion injective representatives
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $X$ be a scheme, and let $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ have torsion cohomology sheaves. Then $K$ admits a bounded-below K-injective representative $I^\bullet$ in complexes of $\Lambda$-module sheaves such that every term $I^m$ is torsion as an underlying abelian sheaf. For every morphism $g:Y'\to Y$ and the induced base-change map $g':X\times_Y Y'\to X$, each inverse-image term $g'^{-1}I^m$ is torsion as well.

source.place: Lemma 0A4B (line 18360) uses injective resolutions for prime coefficients and devisses n-torsion and filtered colimits; the arbitrary-\Lambda coefficient-resolution step is asserted only in the docstring of AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.hasTorsionBaseChange_of_hasInjectiveAcyclicity, BaseChangeProperty.lean lines 309-323
